caption: The video captures a barefoot woman in a pink top and grey flared trousers standing back-to-camera in a dance studio, holding an open paper parasol overhead in her right hand while her front shows in the wall-length mirror at left. Sage-green curtains, a plant, lighting stands and a fan stay fixed, so all motion comes from the dancer. She sinks from an upright stance into a bent-knee plié, hips lowering as her left heel lifts. The left leg rises with a pointed toe, then draws back and settles behind the planted right foot. Her left arm leaves the hip, sweeps outward to the side with the hand extended, and curves back in. The parasol tilts above her head as her torso turns slightly, mirrored in the reflection. The right foot remains the planted support through the whole excerpt.
